name: Amphibian chytridiomycosis with free-living zoospores
description:
Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis in a common toad (Bufo bufo) breeding population.
Structurally an Anderson & May "model G" host–free-living-stage system.
Parameter values: 0 of 11 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Mitchell KM, Churcher TS, Garner TWJ, Fisher MC (2008). Persistence of the emerging pathogen Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis outside the amphibian host greatly increases the probability of host extinction. Proc R Soc B 275(1632):329–334

compartments.name: Zs
compartments.description: free-living zoospores in water (Z written Zs for clarity)

parameters.name: beta_hh
parameters.description: host-to-host transmission coefficient [illustrative] (per toad per day)

parameters.name: beta_z
parameters.description: zoospore-to-host transmission coefficient [illustrative] (per zoospore per day)

parameters.name: mu_z
parameters.description: natural host death rate (8-year life span) [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: prod
parameters.description: zoospore release by infected hosts [illustrative] (zoospores per infected host per day)

parameters.name: rz
parameters.description: maximum saprobic (host-independent) zoospore reproduction rate (per day) [illustrative]

parameters.name: phi
parameters.description: density-dependence of saprobic reproduction; appears as exp(-phi Zs) [verified: the paper uses a density-dependent term of the form exp(−φZ(t))] (per zoospore)

parameters.name: clear_z
parameters.description: zoospore death/loss rate (the survival time this implies is the key parameter the authors vary) [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: rec
parameters.description: host recovery rate (set 0 for the baseline; chytrid clearance is limited) [illustrative] (per day)
